blocking_reason: No supported live entry exists that runs runner -> parser -> P8 -> P9 -> P10. The canonical audit path and the P9 review runtime actively reject every non-offline provider; enabling live operation would change mandatory release gates and add a new live-operation capability, which this work order and the frozen AA-P10/1.0 contract exclude. Replaying live bytes through --offline would record them as 'RECORDED OFFLINE / SYNTHETIC; no live model execution' with model 'offline-recording-no-live-model' and is therefore not used.

Reads message.content[0].text. Adaptive thinking is on by default on both models, so a thinking block can precede the text block.
MAX_TRANSPORT_RETRIES=2 SDK retries; counted via httpx hook but not reserved individually in a budget ledger.
DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS=4096 must cover adaptive thinking plus the Phase-8 JSON; truncation risk, especially at Sonnet default effort 'high'.
Registered models are claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-opus-4-5-20251101 only; no 5.5 runtime contract or effort profile.
